bear_case: Counter-argument: nine consecutive failures at 7,460 reframe the gate as a distributional ceiling. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence, Iran stood down, Alphabet joined the Dow at 7x Verizon's price weight, and Q2 closed at its strongest performance in five years — and SPX still finished 11 points short. The window dressing mechanical tailwind expires tonight. BTC at ~$58,500 on back-to-back Nasdaq surge sessions confirms speculative capital is consistently selling into equity strength — historically a precursor to equity distribution catching up to the downside. Prediction markets assign 44.5% probability to a contractionary ISM print. At Nasdaq P/E ~28x, a three-hike NFP (>200K) produces 12-15% multiple compression math through the unhedgeable July 4 gap. Invalidation: SPX closes above 7,460 AND VIX closes below 17 simultaneously on July 1 or July 2, followed by Goldilocks NFP (130-170K, wages +0.2%) — BUY upgrade validated with multi-week conviction into Q3 earnings season.
